title: Local task-board HTTP API
prompt: Build an in-memory HTTP task board. POST /tasks accepts only title and optional status (todo by default, or done); title must be a trimmed nonempty string of at most 120 characters. Return 201 with {id,title,status}, where id is a stable nonempty string. GET /tasks/:id returns that object or 404. PATCH /tasks/:id accepts one or both of title/status, validates the entire update before mutation, and returns the updated object; an empty update or unknown field is invalid. DELETE /tasks/:id returns 204 with no body, or 404. GET /tasks returns {items,total} ordered by creation, optionally filtered by status, then paginated by offset (integer >=0, default 0) and limit (integer 1..100, default 20); total is the filtered count before pagination. Invalid status, paging, malformed JSON, array bodies, unknown fields and invalid titles return 400 without mutating state. Unknown IDs return 404. No persistence, user accounts or external services are needed. Start with an empty board.
